<body>
<p>Apple Inc. today announced a multi-year supply agreement with Bellwether Semiconductor
Holdings covering advanced packaging capacity through 2029. The agreement follows the
qualification of Bellwether's CoWoS-class line in Hsinchu.</p>
<p>&quot;Securing packaging capacity early is how we keep the roadmap on schedule,&quot; said the
company's chief operating officer. Apple expects first shipments under the agreement in the
second half of 2027.</p>
